title: QPB harness plan
description: Top-level plan document the harness skill reads on first tick. Drives the state machine: each entry becomes one job in queue/. Schema is A2A-ready (task_id is UUID, schema_version is string) so a future v1.6.x can wrap it in a Task envelope without redesign.

task_id.description: UUID identifying this plan as a whole. Each entry derives its own task_id.

schema_version.description: Schema-version pin. Currently '1'. Harness warns on mismatch.

tick_interval_minutes.description: Cadence at which the scheduled task re-invokes the harness skill. Default 10.

pool_size.description: Maximum number of jobs in flight (state=claimed) at once. Default 3 per Council A-3 in-process cap.

stall_threshold_minutes.description: Global stall threshold. Heartbeat older than this -> state=stalled. Default 45.

early_warn_minutes.description: Intermediate stall-warning threshold; surfaces stall warnings in harness_status.json when last_heartbeat_at exceeds this but is still below stall_threshold_minutes. Default 10 (midpoint between the 3-min keepalive cadence and the 45-min global cutoff, giving the operator ~35 min lead time to investigate before fast-fail).

entries.description: One entry per plan job. Each becomes one job in queue/ on first tick.

repo.description: Absolute path or URL of the target repo to audit.

dispatch_mode.description: Mode 1 (subagent) / Mode 2 (cross_cli) / Mode 3 (operator_manual) per the harness SKILL.md.

cli_command.description: Required when dispatch_mode=cross_cli. Example: 'copilot --model claude-sonnet-4.6 --allow-all' or 'codex --model gpt-5.5'.

worker_prompt_template.description: Path (relative to the run-dir) or inline template the harness fills in with absolute path block + task_id + repo. The filled prompt is what the worker reads.
